name: Choirwraith

baseline.name: Choirwraith
baseline.look: Pale translucent mothlike cave predator with resonant throat membranes.
baseline.ecology: Mimics recently heard sounds to draw prey toward sheltered ice pockets.
baseline.limit: Copies fragments, not a dead person’s mind; warmth weakens the membranes.
baseline.encounter: Verify a voice with an agreed visual signal and retreat to warm refuge.
baseline.scale_note: Adult representative staging envelope; individuals vary by up to 10%. Not shown at common scale on the art plate.

daily: In cold ice pockets this mothlike predator waits with folded wings. Resonant throat membranes reproduce fragments it recently heard. The lure is behavior, not knowledge of a listener’s grief.
cycle: Young shelter in cold crevices. Adults range farther when natural prey becomes scarce. Warm civic caverns limit their activity; they do not comfortably stalk the town indoors.
signs: A repeated syllable has the same damaged edge each time. Powder disturbed by wing wash and a pale membrane flicker can confirm an animal; an echo alone cannot.
escalation: Folded wait -> fragment repetition -> short glide toward prey -> retreat from warmth. It may repeat a voice outside the context in which it heard it.
community: Hushvale travelers agree a visible check signal before separating. Archive interpreters distinguish animal mimicry from echo-ice playback and from living witnesses.
scene: Ysolde hears a familiar phrase and identifies the mechanism correctly. The emotional challenge remains: admitting what she wanted the voice to mean.
motion: Design folded and open wing silhouettes with the same landmarks. Throat pulses accompany copied fragments. No ghostly face morph or floating human apparition.
sounds: Only fragments acquired in the current encounter or documented recent exposure. Never reveal secrets the creature could not have heard.
rule: Predatory animal, not a spirit or resurrected person. Five-metre wing span; heat weakens the membranes.
canon_status: Additive ecology and production guidance; proposed scene remains unadopted.
